description: A PHP class providing static utility methods for campaign type and status handling, including translation keys and eCPM calculation.

classes.name: OX_Util_Utils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for campaign type/status management and eCPM calculation.

methods.name: getCampaignType
methods.description: Determines campaign type based on priority value.

methods.name: getCampaignTypeTranslationKey
methods.description: Returns translation key for campaign type based on priority.

methods.name: getCampaignTypeDescriptionTranslationKey
methods.description: Returns description translation key for campaign type based on priority.

methods.name: getCampaignTypeName
methods.description: Returns campaign type name using global variables.

methods.name: getCampaignStatusTranslationKey
methods.description: Returns translation key for campaign status based on status code.

methods.name: getCampaignStatusName
methods.description: Returns campaign status name using global variables.

methods.name: getEcpm
methods.description: Calculates effective CPM (eCPM) based on revenue type and campaign metrics.
